products.name: AWS IAM Identity Center + Microsoft Entra SSO Federation — Commercial
products.short_description: Sign in to AWS with your Microsoft identities — federate AWS IAM Identity Center with Entra ID for SSO and automated user provisioning.
products.description:
Sign in to AWS with your Microsoft identities — federate AWS IAM Identity Center with Entra ID for SSO and automated user provisioning.

Standalone IAM users in AWS mean unmanaged credentials and no lifecycle. This solution federates AWS IAM Identity Center with Microsoft Entra ID as the identity provider — SAML SSO plus SCIM auto-provisioning — and maps Entra groups to least-privilege permission sets across every AWS account.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Terraform, CLI & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • AWS IAM Identity Center enablement (org-wide) and delegated admin
  • Entra ID enterprise app: SAML SSO + SCIM user/group provisioning
  • Permission sets mapped to Entra groups (least privilege)
  • Multi-account access assignments and session controls
  • Break-glass and decommissioning of legacy IAM users

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One Microsoft identity signing in to every AWS account with least-privilege, auto-provisioned access — no standalone IAM users to leak.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AWSSSO-Discovery.sh — read-only discovery of the IAM Identity Center + legacy
    • AWSSSO-Entra-Provisioning.ps1 — GATED helper to create the Entra enterprise
    • AWSSSO-Report.sh — read-only report of the group -> permission set -> account
    • AWSSSO-Validate.ps1 — read-only validation of the Entra ID side of the AWS

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
